query: Which is larger by area, Canada or the United States?
answer:
Canada is bigger by total area. It covers about 9.98 million km² (3.85 million sq mi), compared with about 9.83 million km² (3.80 million sq mi) for the United States [1][2]. That makes Canada the second-largest country in the world, after Russia, and the US third or fourth depending on how its area is measured.

The answer changes if you count only land. Canada has so many lakes and so much other fresh water that the US has slightly more dry land, about 9.15 million km² against Canada's 9.09 million km² [2].

Sources:
[1] IndexMundi, "Canada vs. United States – Geography" (from the CIA World Factbook): https://www.indexmundi.com/factbook/compare/canada.united-states/geography
[2] Flytrippers, "Canada or the U.S.: Which country is larger in terms of land area (excluding water)?": https://flytrippers.com/canada-or-usa-which-country-is-larger-in-terms-of-land-area-excluding-water
